goal: Is ke baad aap cout se text aur values print kar sakein ge, cin se keyboard se values parh sakein ge, aur endl, \n aur chaining use kar sakein ge.
warmup: Sochein ke aap canteen ke counter par order de rahe hain. Cashier poochta hai, 'Kaunsi cheez?' (output), aap kehte hain 'Samosa, 2 pieces' (input), aur phir cashier aap ko bill batata hai (output). Program bhi yehi karta hai: woh cout se message dikhata hai, cin se aap ke type karne ka intezar karta hai, aur phir cout se result dikhata hai.
definition: cout (console output) insertion operator << ke zariye text aur values ko screen par bhejta hai. cin (console input) extraction operator >> ke zariye keyboard par type ki hui values ko variables mein parhta hai. Dono ke liye #include <iostream> chahiye. Arrows data ki direction dikhate hain: << cout ki taraf hai (data bahar jata hai), >> cin se door variable ki taraf hai (data andar aata hai).
howItWorks: Visualize tab par Play dabayein. Jab program cin tak pahunchta hai to woh user ka intezar karta hai. Type ki hui value variable ke box mein chali jati hai. Phir cout text aur variables ki maujooda values print karta hai. Aap ek hi statement mein kai cheezein chain kar sakte hain: cout << a << b; ya cin >> a >> b; User type ki hui values ko space ya Enter se alag karta hai. string par cin >> sirf ek lafz parhta hai, yeh pehle space par ruk jata hai.
